name: Fond
description:
Fond shows how AI assistants answer questions in your market: which brands they mention, which sources they cite, where brands appear in each answer, and how those results change over time.

Connect Fond to Claude to investigate questions such as:

- "Why did my visibility drop this week?"
- "Which articles cite my competitors but not me?"
- "Where am I losing share of voice, and which competitors are gaining?"
- "What should I work on next?"

Depending on the data available in your Fond account, Claude can help you explore:

- Your visibility across AI assistants, including mentions, brand position, sentiment, feed quality, and historical trends.
- Your share of voice across competitors, markets, and search intent.
- Citation gaps and the sources influencing AI answers.
- Changes in competitor visibility, rank, mentions, and sentiment.
- Recommended actions supported by evidence from your Fond data.

Fond identifies the measurement run behind each result, so Claude can distinguish current data from stale data. If the required data is unavailable, Fond reports that instead of estimating an answer.

The connector is read-only. It cannot change your Fond account, create or delete data, or act on your behalf. You choose which organizations Claude can access when you connect Fond, and you can disconnect at any time.

A Fond account on an active plan with at least one fully configured website is required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fond to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fond to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.tryfond.co/api/mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fond MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fond provides these MCP tools: get_citation_gaps, get_competitor_movement, get_share_of_voice, get_visibility_summary, list_recommended_actions, and list_websites.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fond?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fond in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Fond requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fond is developed by Fond. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
